justifications.durability: the two moved monkeypatches guard the promotion call name: tests/test_rollback_asks_head.py:183 points the capture injection at promotion.capture_run_session and tests/test_rollback_asks_head.py:274 and tests/test_a_promotion_never_reads_unpromoted.py:187 patch it directly, so re-reverting promotion.py to call _capture_member_session would leave the patch on a name the code no longer calls (or raise AttributeError on the removed import) and redden all three; the recorded negative control (negative-control.log, 3 failed EXIT=1) demonstrates exactly that sensitivity by aiming each patch at promotion.scoped_diff_stat. The weaker half: no test asserts the alias is absent tree-wide, the done-when's primary guard is a manual grep, and the changed calls at dispatch_sessions.py:360 and promotion_records.py:185 have no moved patch, so those two call sites carry no automated regression guard.
justifications.evidence: the done_when's three clauses are each recorded against a log under the run: the alias grep is empty at head (measured here) and present at base, gate-head.log records "24 passed in 53.82s" EXIT=0 against gate-base.log's "24 passed in 81.19s" EXIT=0 (0 added failures), and ruff.log reports no new finding in head vs base with format both "3 files would be reformatted"; the head arm's own log header names the base revision (gate-head.log:1), so the head sha is only in the manifest's after_suite block, a labelling weakness rather than a missing result.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's import idiom, moving the changed callers onto the same `from reckon.crew.runs import (...)` block that already owns capture_run_session (reckon/crew/promotion.py:128, reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:34), and it adds no symbol, filename, comment or ticket reference the naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal is that the _capture_member_session alias is deleted and every caller uses capture_run_session; `git grep _capture_member_session 15dff49be -- reckon/ tests/` prints nothing (exit 1) against 7 files at the base, and the diff repoints the call at reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:360, the calls at reckon/crew/promotion.py:763 and reckon/crew/promotion.py:1370 and the call at reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:185, with the two imports and the dispatch.py:2874 re-export and the reckon/crew.py _MODULE_EXPORTS entry removed.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no definition at all: it deletes the alias and routes all four call sites through the sole owner capture_run_session (reckon/crew/runs.py:91), which the repository already owns; a capability search over reckon/ for `def capture`/`capture_run_session` found no other run-session capture mechanism (reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1235 is a nested per-response capture and reckon/velocity.py:797 a project capture, both unrelated), so there is nothing to fork.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the plan §10 write paths and the source manifest's changed_paths: the seven files touched are exactly reckon/crew.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, reckon/crew/promotion_records.py, tests/test_rollback_asks_head.py and tests/test_a_promotion_never_reads_unpromoted.py, and the diff carries no evidence fragment, figure or unrelated edit.
